snippet.title: Flock Hunt Announcement Trailer | Wishlist Now on Steam!
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5542020/Flock_Hunt/

A first-person stealth game about taking down mass surveillance cameras and fighting a dystopian future. Every camera you break brings The Flock a little closer. Sneak out at night and destroy cameras with a growing arsenal of tools, sell camera scrap for upgrades, and hire a crew.

Developed by Phobos Base, my independent game development studio.
